topicData.topic: Commission starts enforcing AI Act rules and new transparency requirements on 2 August
topicData.angle: Write from the specific facts and details in the source material provided.

postText:
Enforcement started before the rulebook is finished.

That is what actually happened on 2 August. The EU AI Act began enforcement. General purpose AI models now need transparency documentation, copyright summaries, and energy consumption data. The code of practice companies are supposed to follow is still being drafted.

I have watched compliance programmes inside large organisations before. The pattern that breaks them is not complexity. It is ambiguity. You can resource your way through complex. You cannot resource your way through "we will tell you the rules once you have already built the thing."

A telecoms operator with 28,000 employees and a facilities management firm sound nothing like each other when this conversation starts. But both have the same problem right now. Legal wants to wait for clarity. The AI programme is already running. And nobody owns the gap between them.

That gap is where the exposure lives.

If you are inside a large organisation trying to work out who actually owns GPAI compliance right now, I am genuinely curious what that looks like.

#EnterpriseAI #TechLeadership #DigitalTransformation
